name: SMACS J0217.1-5244 (Hubble)
blurb: SMACS J0217.1-5244, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: smacsj0217-hubble
story: SMACS J0217.1-5244 was chosen for a Hubble snapshot survey of the most massive, X-ray-bright galaxy clusters, a hunt for the most powerful gravitational telescopes in the distant universe.

claims.text: SMACSJ0217.1-5244 is a target of the Beyond MACS snapshot survey of the most massive galaxy clusters
The survey targets the most X-ray luminous distant clusters
The survey aims to find the most powerful gravitational telescopes
